title: Hermetic Observation v1
description: Hermetic execution observation for Gate A1. It records process, input-tree, sandbox-authority, output-tree, duration, exit, and stdout/stderr facts. Interpretation belongs to the independent reducer. clockUsage, randomUsage, and networkUsage are closed execution-profile declarations and remain const false.

executionMode.description: Execution release marker assigned by the harness from the observed sandbox authority. A dev PGID run or unavailable external isolation is recorded as NON_RELEASE.

clockUsage.description: Verifier capability declaration: clock must not be used for entropy or timing side-channels. const false because clock access is a capability, not an observed fact.

randomUsage.description: Verifier capability declaration: random must derive from sandbox-controlled entropy source only. const false because random access is a capability, not an observed fact.

networkUsage.description: Verifier capability declaration: network access is prohibited. const false because network access is a capability, not an observed fact.

codeSourceBeforeDigest.description: ContentDigest (SHA256 raw bytes) of JAR before class loading.

codeSourceAfterDigest.description: ContentDigest (SHA256 raw bytes) of JAR after class loading, before close.

codeSourceManifestDigest.description: ContentDigest of Manifest.mf for the JAR.

openFileDescriptors.description: Count of file descriptors still open at the quiescence observation point.

cgroupMembers.description: Count of processes remaining in the cgroup at the quiescence observation point.

childProcesses.description: Count of unreaped child processes at the quiescence observation point.

toctouDetected.description: Boolean fact: true if a TOCTOU condition was observed during execution. Per 03 §7 A1_Hermetic_013.

escapeDetected.description: Boolean fact: true if the process escaped the sandbox via setsid or a PGID change. Per 03 §7 A1_Hermetic_007.

detachedChildEscaped.description: Boolean fact: true if a detached child continued after the pipe closed. Per 03 §7 A1_Hermetic_010.

quiescenceUnprovable.description: Boolean fact: true if the Observer could not establish quiescence for this execution. Per 03 §7 A1_Hermetic_009.

exitCode.description: Process exit code; null if not exited normally.

exitSignal.description: Signal number if terminated by signal; null otherwise.

stdoutLength.description: Number of stdout bytes covered by stdoutHash.

stderrLength.description: Number of stderr bytes covered by stderrHash.

logFileDetected.description: Boolean fact: true if log files were observed in the sandbox. Per 03 §7 A1_Hermetic_016.

secretInStdoutStderr.description: Boolean fact: true if a configured sensitive prefix was observed in stdout or stderr. Per 03 §7 A1_Hermetic_017.

spiMaterializationNonUnique.description: Boolean fact: true if ServiceLoader materialization was not unique. Per 03 §7 A1_Hermetic_014.

pathLeakDetected.description: Boolean fact: true if the process accessed a path outside the snapshot tree. Per 03 §7 A1_Hermetic_019.
